commitMessage: Extract runAcceptAllClarityCallback helper and add regression test proving onAcceptAllClaritySections is never called when all sections are stale post-review
buildWarnings: Bundle chunk >500 kB after minification — code splitting recommended

technologyStack.persistence: None for clinical data; localStorage for 3 UI preference keys only
technologyStack.backend: None (api-server artifact exists but is not consumed by Sunrise OS frontend)
technologyStack.aiEngine: Rule-based local engine (no external API calls)
technologyStack.typescript: Strict-ish (noImplicitAny, strictNullChecks, noImplicitReturns; strict umbrella not set)

knownAuditLimitations: Audit is code-inspection based — no real production environment exists to test against
All workflows tested against demo/mock data — real payer, pharmacy, and lab responses not tested
Security assessment is a technical gap review only — not a penetration test or formal HIPAA risk analysis
Performance metrics are based on bundle analysis only — no load testing performed
Accessibility assessment is manual/heuristic — not a formal WCAG audit or screen-reader test
Role permission matrix is derived from source code — backend enforcement does not exist to verify
All 10 end-to-end workflows complete only at the UI level — no data is persisted between sessions
Screenshots limited due to authentication requirement — captured login screen only
API server routes were not individually tested for authorization
